reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation deterministically derives the recommendation from the first retained priority: because the first priority in the supplied output is supported, it returns decision maintain and top_need preserve immutable review attempts. The incorrect business result is upstream of this boundary in priority ordering, not in recommendation synthesis.

map_coverage preserves all eight handoff records from the supplied needs and marks coverage by exact need equality against the capability list. The two needs without capabilities, n06-r01 and n06-r07, remain visible as unsupported, while the six matching needs are marked direct.

prioritize_needs reverses market-demand priority by sorting supported direct coverage before unsupported needs and by placing larger provenance_rank values first. This makes the lowest-demand supported record n06-r08 priority 1 while the highest-demand unsupported record n06-r01 is pushed to priority 8, causing the final recommendation to maintain instead of surfacing the strongest unsupported demand signal.
